findings.claim: The guard does not tie the write path or the script's wiki argument to the current project root. A classifier steered by injected text can Write or Edit <any absolute dir>/docs/wiki/evidence.md, for example another project's page, and run the script on any such directory. Read, Grep and Glob are also unrestricted.
evidence: isPage and isScriptCall only require an absolute, cleaned path with the right suffix; neither is compared to a project root, and Call carries no root
CHANGELOG and README call it a text-matching speed bump; residual reach limited to overwriting other projects' evidence pages
evidence.sh only reads; the page path must end in /docs/wiki/evidence.md; no other tool allowed
